Name: Stairdew - Staircase Upgrade Mod
Author: ThatBritishMo
Description:
[size=5][b]Stairdew - The Staircase Upgrade Mod[/b]

[/size][size=3]This mod isn't about making your life too easy. 
We wanted to design something that fit seamlessly into the general vibe of Stardew, giving you an advantage but still making you feel as though you were working hard.
Much like a tool upgrade that takes some effort to gain, the rewards for doing so are substantial. 
With Stairdew you still need to work hard obtaining the materials needed for better staircases, but the result is rewarding, especially if you're interested in exploring deeper down the Skull Caverns mid/late game for resources. [/size]

[size=3]Stairdew allows you to craft copper, steel, gold, and iridium staircases which will allow you to travel 10, 20, 40, and 99 floors down the mines and Skull Caverns respectively

[/size][quote]Copper Staircase: 20 Copper Bars
10 floors 
[b]Unlocks at mining level 4[/b]
[size=3]
[/size]Steel Staircase: 20 Iron Bars
20 floors 
[b]Unlocks at mining level 6[/b]
[size=3]
[/size]Gold Staircase: 20 Gold Bars
40 floors 
[b]Unlocks at mining level 8[/b]
[size=3]
[/size]Iridium Staircase: 20 Iridium Bars
99 floors 
[b]Unlocks at mining level 10[/b][/quote]
[size=3]The 99 floor cap means that when you're at floor 1 of the Skull Caverns, you can get straight to floor 100 through the use of a single iridium staircase. Does this mean Mr. Qi will be impressed with you or will he be angry that you used stairs? Try it and let us know.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/42016/42016-1770252449-2124676083.png[/img]
[list]
[b]
[/b][/list][b][size=5]Installation Instructions:
[/size][/b]﻿
[size=3]Simply unzip the contents of the file into your Stardew /Mods folder and run SMAPI.
[u]Note that you must have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed[/u]

A huge shoutout to [url=https://ko-fi.com/imnotashrimp83]imnotashrimp83 [/url]who did the wonderful artwork for the staircases. 
Please donate to her here: [url=https://ko-fi.com/imnotashrimp83]https://ko-fi.com/imnotashrimp83
